EVIDENCE_LABELS.RETROSPECTIVE_2023_2024: RETROSPECTIVE_EVIDENCE. Never a holdout, never a final confirmation: the rule reached the project as a working scheme from this period and 2024 is owner-exposed.
EVIDENCE_LABELS.OBSERVABLE: RETROSPECTIVE_PROXY_TO_OWNER_OBSERVABLE. Binance UM perp bookDepth within 5%; the owner watched a Hyblock spot bid/ask 0-5% indicator.

CLAIM.TEXT: On BTCUSDT perpetual 1h bars, at a confirmed swing low that makes a lower low after a pronounced decline, the conjunction of order-book bid support within 5% and regular bullish divergence in at least 2 of 3 indicator families (arm A) reaches +1R before -1R within 48h more often than support alone (arm B) and than divergence alone (arm C), after the frozen adjustment set.
CLAIM.OBJECT: order-book support x regular divergence state; CVD is one of three divergence families
NOT_THE_CLAIM: taker imbalance predicts future return (H05, rejected, stays closed)
book support alone predicts a bounce
mean reversion after a decline (A vs D)
CLAIM.DIRECTION: A above B and A above C

NUISANCE_REALIZATION.PRIOR_REALIZED_VOLATILITY: RV24: sample SD (ddof 1) of the 24 hourly log close-to-close returns ending at bar i+3; entered as log(RV24)
NUISANCE_REALIZATION.TIME_OF_DAY: UTC hour of the decision time T; entered as sin(2 pi h/24) and cos(2 pi h/24)
NUISANCE_REALIZATION.LAGGED_TARGET: DECLINE_ATR: (max high of bars i-48..i minus low_i) / ATR14(i). The magnitude of the preceding decline is the lagged-target term (seed V1 framing); its eligibility threshold stays a mechanism variable
NUISANCE_REALIZATION.PRE_DECISION_NET_FLOW: NETFLOW24: sum(2 taker_buy - volume) / sum(volume) over the 24 bars ending at bar i+3
NUISANCE_REALIZATION.RISK_WIDTH_ATR: RISK_ATR: (close of bar i+3 - low_i) / ATR14(i). Card-specific, added at design: the bracket width relative to volatility drives the chance of a 48h timeout. The owner may strike it before outcomes are opened; nothing may be added after.

DISCOVERY.RULE: decision time T with T + 96h <= 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, so every primary and sensitivity window ends inside 2024

SURFACES.PROTECTED: No byte dated 2025-01-01 or later is fetched for the retrospective test. Protected 2025/2026 stays sealed.

BOOKDEPTH.FIELDS_USED: timestamp (UTC), percentage in {-5, +5}, notional (cumulative within the band)
BOOKDEPTH.VERIFIED_AGAINST: the published .CHECKSUM; every object SHA256 is pinned in the dataset manifest written by the count pass
BOOKDEPTH.MISSING_DAY: recorded; affected hours are NaN and their episodes are excluded and counted

DEFINITIONS.S2_BARS: UTC 1h bars [h, h+1h) from 1m klines; a bar needs all 60 minutes, otherwise it is incomplete and splits the series into segments. Indicators restart in each segment.
DEFINITIONS.S3_EVENT: Swing low at bar i: low_i < min(low_{i-3..i-1}) and low_i <= min(low_{i+1..i+3}). Decision time T = close of bar i+3. Pronounced decline: max(high_{i-48..i}) - low_i >= 3.0 x ATR14(i). Comparison pivot j: the most recent swing low with i-48 <= j <= i-5; the episode needs low_i < low_j (lower low), otherwise it is outside the population. The episode needs i at least 720 bars into its segment and bars i..i+3 in the same segment.
DEFINITIONS.S4_DIVERGENCE: Values at the pivot bars i and j. RSI family: Wilder RSI14(i) > RSI14(j) AND RSI21(i) > RSI21(j). MACD family: MACD line EMA12(close) - EMA26(close) at i > at j (EMA alpha 2/(n+1), seeded with the first close; the signal line is unused). CVD family: sum over bars j+1..i of (2 taker_buy - volume) > 0. Divergence = at least 2 of the 3 families. Strict inequalities, no minimum difference.
DEFINITIONS.S5_SUPPORT: Hourly imbalance = mean over snapshots t in [h, h+1h) of (bid5 - ask5)/(bid5 + ask5), bid5/ask5 = cumulative notional at percentage -5/+5; an hour needs >= 60 valid snapshots. Support = some hour among i+1, i+2, i+3 has imbalance > 0 AND >= the 0.80 quantile (numpy linear) of the present hourly values of hours i-719..i, with at least 480 present. Any missing support hour excludes the episode; fewer than 480 trailing hours excludes it as immature.
DEFINITIONS.S6_ARMS: A = support and divergence; B = support without divergence; C = divergence without support; D = neither.
DEFINITIONS.S6_EXCLUSIONS: First match, counted in the funnel: kline window incomplete; not a pronounced decline; no comparison pivot; not a lower low; risk width < 0.25 ATR14(i); a support hour missing; book baseline immature.
DEFINITIONS.S7_ADJUSTMENT: See VARIABLE_ROLES.NUISANCE_REALIZATION. No covariate may be added after outcomes.
DEFINITIONS.PIT: Every field of an episode uses bars up to i+3 and book hours up to i+3 only, all closed at T. Tested by truncation invariance: data ending at T reproduce the same record.

ENDPOINTS.ENTRY: E = close of bar i+3 (the decision price at T)
ENDPOINTS.STOP: S = low_i; the stop event is the first 1m bar after T with low < S
ENDPOINTS.RISK: R = E - S (> 0.25 ATR14(i) by eligibility)
ENDPOINTS.TARGET_K: the first 1m bar after T with high >= E + k R
ENDPOINTS.SAME_MINUTE: stop and target in the same minute count as the stop (loss)
ENDPOINTS.TIMEOUT: neither within the cap counts as failure
ENDPOINTS.MISSING_PATH_MINUTE: an episode with any missing minute in its window is UNAVAILABLE for that endpoint, decided from timestamps only, and reported

CELLS.ESTIMAND: adjusted risk difference P(Y1_48H) A minus B
adjusted risk difference P(Y1_48H) A minus C

PRIMARY_TEST_FAMILY.MODEL: linear probability model on all eligible BTC episodes: Y1_48H ~ 1 + A + B + C (D reference) + log RV24 + sin(hour) + cos(hour) + DECLINE_ATR + NETFLOW24 + RISK_ATR
PRIMARY_TEST_FAMILY.VARIANCE: CR1 cluster-robust, clusters = UTC weeks starting Monday 00:00 (WEEK_ANCHOR_MS), t reference with G - 1 degrees of freedom
PRIMARY_TEST_FAMILY.TEST: two-sided p for beta_A - beta_B and beta_A - beta_C
PRIMARY_TEST_FAMILY.STATISTICAL_GATE: Holm rejects both P1 and P2 (smaller p <= 0.025 and larger p <= 0.05) and both estimates are positive
PRIMARY_TEST_FAMILY.DEPENDENCE_NOTE: a 48h window spans at most two weekly clusters; the share of windows crossing a week boundary and the 48h overlap-chain structure are reported by the feasibility pass

PRACTICAL_GATE.COST_BASIS: 0.04% taker fee per side and 0.01% slippage per side
RULES: the adjusted A rate (mean fitted value over all eligible episodes with the arm set to A) >= the mean over A episodes of 0.5 + (0.0010 / RISK_FRACTION) / 2, the break-even rate of a 1R:1R bracket with timeouts counted as full losses

EPOCH_GATE.ROLE: HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION_CONTRACT_V1 section 4 gate, run on each primary contrast. No half-year needs to be individually significant; the epochs detect concentration. Primary inference stays the frozen clustered analysis.
EPOCH_GATE.EPOCH_ESTIMATE: within-epoch LPM with arm dummies only, CR1 by week
EPOCH_GATE.HETEROGENEITY_TEST: Q = sum_e (theta_e - theta_w)^2 / se_e^2 against a block permutation of whole weekly clusters across epochs (week counts per epoch kept), seed 20261003, 2000 draws, alpha_het 0.05
EPOCH_GATE.OPPOSITE_SIGN_TEST: an epoch fails if its estimate has the sign opposite to the pooled estimate with one-sided p < 0.05
EPOCH_GATE.LOW_POWER: if the feasibility pass finds the gate NOT_ASSESSABLE it cannot fail the card, and records say heterogeneity could not be reliably assessed at this N, never stable
EPOCH_GATE.DIAGNOSTICS: largest epoch share of A episodes and leave-one-epoch-out estimates, reported, never deciding

SECONDARY_AND_SENSITIVITY.RULE: descriptive only; none changes the primary conclusion

H05_DISTANCE.STATEMENT: The CVD family is close to the rejected H05_TAKER_IMBALANCE_SUBSEQUENT_RETURN. This card does not test whether taker imbalance predicts future return, and H05 stays closed.
WHY_DIFFERENT: the object is the order-book support x regular divergence state; CVD is only one of three divergence families and never sufficient on its own
